introduction: This view of the Tarantula Nebula assigns three observatories to three color channels.
observe: Separate the blue, green and red structures mentally before reading the legend.
Notice where two or more colors overlap.
explanation: The composite contains X-ray data from Chandra, optical data from Hubble and infrared data from Spitzer.
colorMethod: Chandra X-rays are blue, Hubble optical observations are green and Spitzer infrared observations are red.
whyItMatters: A shared color legend lets one image compare energetic gas, visible structures and infrared-emitting material.
